intro.label: Who we are
intro.title: Your Trusted Event Partner in Cambodia
intro.subtitle: We Create, You Celebrate
intro.description: MPG Event Planner is an event planning and production company based in Phnom Penh. We work with companies, shops, schools, NGOs and private clients to plan, build and run events across Cambodia.
intro.para2: One team handles the whole event: concept and budget, stage and backdrop, sound and lighting, decoration, guest flow, and management on site the day it happens.

pillars.desc: P3 HD LED walls, line-array concert sound systems & programmable DMX lighting.

pillars.label: On-site

process.label: How we work
process.title: Our Working Process
process.subtitle: How we turn your ideas into a flawlessly executed event.

steps.title: Consultation
steps.desc: We align on your goals, event type, guest count and budget.

steps.title: Proposal
steps.desc: You receive a layout, an equipment list and a clear price.

steps.title: Planning
steps.desc: We design the backdrop, confirm the programme and prepare permissions.

steps.title: Preparation
steps.desc: We build off site, then set up and test everything at the venue.

steps.title: Execution
steps.desc: Our team runs the event on the day and packs down afterwards.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.content: At MPG Event Planner, we value your privacy. We collect the information provided through our quotation form solely to prepare accurate proposals, coordinate event logistics, and contact you about your event. Your details are stored securely and are never shared with third parties without your explicit permission.
